subject: Insurance
title: Hurricane Katrina
description: A short lesson to help you apply Hurricane Katrina.

hook.text: Katrina hit New Orleans in 2005 and caused $82 billion in insured losses.

buildup.text: Levees broke, flooding 80% of the city. 1,800 people died.

discovery.text: Most flood damage wasn't covered. Standard homeowner policies exclude flooding.

twist.text: Insurers and policyholders fought over whether damage was from wind (covered) or flooding (excluded).

climax.text: Katrina exposed the flood insurance gap. Millions believed they were covered. They weren't.

punchline.text: $82 billion in losses. Most flood damage wasn't even covered by insurance.

quiz.question: Why were many Hurricane Katrina victims underinsured?
options: They chose not to buy insurance
